title: Tabata Squats
creator: Izumi Tabata (protocol); community variant
description: The Tabata clock applied to air squats: eight rounds of 20 seconds of as many squats as possible with 10 seconds off. The usual score is the lowest rep count of any round, which punishes going out too fast. Four minutes, no equipment.
